dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with OO extensions (class-control, invoke, object reference), Dialog System (DS-CONTROL-BLOCK, CALL-DIALOG-SYSTEM), and Micro Focus copybook conventions (.MF extension). Brazilian Portuguese application.

purpose.domain_detail: Laboratory/photo film analysis system (LBP prefix suggests laboratorio de processamento de filmes - revealed/developed film analysis). Tracks film processing by employee, shift, film type, and interruption type within a date range.
purpose.summary: Program LBP201 lists analyses of developed/revealed films within a user-specified date range. It loads data from indexed files (LBD021, LBD023, LBD029, LBD101) into a work file, then displays results in a list sorted by various criteria (date, employee, shift, film type). It calculates elapsed processing time accounting for interruptions.

notable_features: Micro Focus OO COBOL extensions (class-control, invoke, object reference)
22 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
PRINTER IS LPRINTER with named printer
Multiple ALTERNATE RECORD KEYs on WORK file
Time calculation using GRTIME external subprogram
Brazilian Portuguese comments and variable names
